questions.question: Discuss the impact of genetic disorders such as Turner syndrome and Klinefelter syndrome on growth and development. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Discuss the impact of genetic disorders such as Turner syndrome and Klinefelter syndrome
  • on growth and development.
  • • Both are genetic disorders affecting sex chromosomes.
  • • Turner syndrome causes short stature and delayed puberty in females.
  • • Klinefelter syndrome leads to tall stature and low muscle mass in males.
  • • Both may cause motor skill and coordination difficulties.
  • • Can result in learning and developmental challenges.
  • • Affect physical fitness and participation in activities.
  • • Early treatment and support can improve quality of life.

questions.question: Discuss the impact of sensory deprivation on motor skill development in early childhood. / [CO2]
